summary: Experienced elementary and early childhood educator with roughly a decade of classroom teaching across preschool, kindergarten, and elementary grades, plus high school and junior high assignments in a recent teaching role. Certified Texas teacher for EC through 4th grade with a Bachelor of Arts in Education. Skilled in lesson planning, reading, math, writing, science, and social studies instruction, with a focus on play-based and scaffolded learning and positive classroom management. Also brings prior accounts receivable and customer service experience, including collections, client relations, and reporting, along with proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.
